value.title: Native seat carry needs composed recovery proof

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Atomic index updates and a valid successor chain do not prove that the scoped governance holding reached the live end. Compose the cases: commit A->B's holders document, stop before index admission, then supersede B->C and redo. At reviewed #279 head 31bd3c9, recovery skipped A's row because its recorded destination B differed from C, yet reported the role landed. Mail became Queued/None and completion prevented repair. Require the holding on C AND delivery there before treating that scope as reconciled.

F233's unchanged-product RED is reviewer_r2_second_clear_after_git_before_index_is_recovered; portable receipts: .harness/records/retro/2026-11-20/review-279-r2-overlap.diff and review-279-r2-overlap.log in prime-governance. The isolated index-cut and pre-start two-clear tests passed separately. Verdict ab1a1ac accepted F233 under the prime's C34 ruling; it did not claim the residual healed. Recheck the composed RED when reviewing its fix.

For independent store-proof pressure, removing only all-seat launch equality must break a_carry_moves_nothing_unless_one_launch_crossed_a_native_boundary through its direct-store call, even with daemon guards intact; this non-equivalent mutation was caught.
